notes.title: Version 1.10 is Out! Happy PAC-DOT munching!
notes.content:
We've just released out 1.10 update with some minor fixes and improvements.

[h1]1.10 Change List[/h1] 
[list][*] Coin pickups are now worth more + red coins drop a little more frequently 
[*] Moved everyone to a new clean leaderboard and improved score submission
[*] Mouse will now disappear during gameplay if no movement is detected for 5 seconds
[*] Fixed issue that could prevent number of "256's" from being submitted
[/list]

notes.title: Happy Holidays Update!
notes.content:
We'd like to take this opportunity to wish you all a merry Xmas and a safe and happy new year!

[h1]1.0.8 Change List - Dec 22 2016[/h1] 
[list][*] New themes! We have added the 3 extra themes from the mobile version. The Arcade, Moon Lander & Digital World 
[*] Reduced the time it takes to get from the game over screen, back to the play menu
[/list]

notes.title: Update Time!
notes.content:
Just a minor update to fix a few bugs and move us onto a newer engine version.

[h1]1.0.7 Change List[/h1] 
[list][*] Fixed the global scores & ranks not showing correctly for some players
[*] Fixed some UI being left on screen after leaving the GameOver screen.
[*] Moved to a newer Unity version - game should run faster on most platforms, especially Linux.
[/list]

[b]NOTE[/b] If you are running super old hardware or your hardware is below our minimum specs, and after the update you have graphical issues, please try updating your video drivers.

notes.title: Happy PAC-MAN 256 1st Birthday - Wakka Wakka
notes.content:
To celebrate the 1st birthday of PAC-MAN 256, we have released a nice little update that includes some requested features from the community.

[h1]1.0.5 Change List[/h1]
[list][*] We now hot reload all leaderboards after score submission to work around Steam bug were player ranks are sometimes not updated
[/list]

[h1]1.0.4 Change List[/h1]
[list][*] New global Leaderboards that show the top 100 scores + your own score/rank if you are not in the top 100
[*] Support 2 players on the same keyboard (P1 uses WASD, P2 uses Arrows)
[*] Support of AZERTY keyboards - Switch is in the settings UI
[*] New button to scale User Interface in ‘Graphics’ settings. Switch between 3 scale modes and get the best views on higher resolution or larger screens
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the update!
